title: Soulwarden binding of the behavior trees (format 1)
description: The binding file bindings.jsonc (stage BT2). The loader of the backend (world/tree_binding.cpp) is the authority; this schema is for an editor. JSON with comments, no trailing comma. The narrowest key that matches selects the tree of a creature: kind, vitals, slice, serverTree, creatureType, family, then the binding with no key, then the tree default. A value in two bindings of one key is an error.

values.description: A text or a list of texts, with no difference of upper and lower case.

binding.description: One key and a tree, or only a tree (the binding of each other creature: at most one).

kind.description: The id of a kind of the creature data (Wolf_Grey_7).

vitals.description: The vitals row of a kind.

serverTree.description: A server tree that the slice names in the client data (wolf/wolf_base).

creatureType.description: The creature type of a kind (EliteMiniBoss).
